verses.en: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
verses.sm: Tavita. Ua fai ifo le tagata valea i lona loto, E leai se Atua. Ua leaga lava i latou; ua inosia a latou amioga; e leai se tasi ua amio lelei.

verses.en: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
verses.sm: O loo silasila mai le ALII mai le lagi i le fanau a tagata, ina ia silafia pe ai se tasi ua poto, se ua saili i le Atua.

verses.en: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.sm: Ua latou “alo'alo ese uma lava, ua leaga faatasi i latou; e leai se tasi ua amio lelei, e leai lava se tasi.

verses.en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
verses.sm: E leo Poa ea e i latou uma lava o e fai amio leaga? O loo “auwa e i latou loʻu nuu, e pei ona latou aai i mea e “ai; ua latou le valaau i le ALII.

verses.en: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.sm: Ua matatau tele i latou i lea mea; aua o i le tupulaga o e amiotonu le Atua.

verses.en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
verses.sm: Ua outou faamaina le filifiliga a le ua puapuagaina; aua o lona malu o le ALII lea.

verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.sm: E! fia Poa se na te aumaia mai Siona le faaolataga o Isaraelu. Pe a faafoisia mai e le ALII le tafeaga a lona nuu, ona o.ioli ai lea o Iakopo, e fiafia ai Isaraelu.
